physics: Unmodified F6 M0 / F10C FullParticleBatch; field/flow stride=1
discrete_gate: Exact labels, member masks, sampled lineage, accepted-step raw edge events and persistence events/times
float_rationale: Float64 batched reductions and LAPACK may change final rounding; length atol is one picometre of a micrometre (1e-18 m), much smaller than physical gates; acos near +/-1 uses absolute 1e-5 degree. Degenerate eigenvectors use reference fallback; no tolerance for discrete labels or events.
offline_benchmark: Archived exclusive_v1_batch/B64_batch full201x64x32 input, one first and one warm legacy/optimized pair; instrumented profile separate

family_benchmark.initials: Original legal four translations repeated, BENCHMARK_ONLY

diversity.method: If fewer than four independent archived mature families, hard-sphere random sequential placement in a radius12um ball centered on the actual F10A interior cloud; min center distance2.05R. No retries chosen by scientific success.
diversity.split: Control branches and any prepared descendant remain in the original seed family; do not create a validation split

failure_policy: Original global fail-stop, keep every failed member and accepted prefix; no automatic retry or dropped samples
performance_repetitions: One bounded paired controlled-window comparison per B and startup mode, not a confidence interval
